title: Осадный шар: вес, толпа и живые анимации
scope: Castle horse plus a crowd balloon: five crew + pilot, animated idle/pose on board, weight steering only airborne, load lowers the ceiling and slows controls, responsive flight, visible gusts, live ropes, slower overheat that bursts the balloon; Space is the only vertical control (release to glide down), no anchor and no Shift.
